'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution incidents]]
***According to the [[Gaza Health Ministry]], fourteen [[Palestinians]] are killed and 150 others are injured by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli gunfire]] at an [[humanitarian aid|aid distribution]] site near [[Rafah]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. The total death toll from shootings at aid distribution sites increases to 136 with hundreds others wounded. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-aid-06-09-2025-3a6073a0905a60f9a99625852cf8ad19 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/8/gaza-aid-sites-branded-human-slaughterhouses-under-deadly-israeli-fire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
**A convoy of 300 buses and cars departs from [[Tunis]], [[Tunisia]] to Gaza to spotlight Israel's blockade on humanitarian aid. The group, organized independently, includes 7,000 lawyers, medical professionals and activists from [[North Africa]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/06/09/land-convoy-sets-off-for-gaza-from-tunisia-to-protest-against-israeli-blockade-of-strip (Euronews)] [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/7000-activists-begin-300-vehicle-convoy-from-tunisia-to-rafah-aim-to-open-corridor/ar-AA1Gskv2?ocid=BingNewsVerp (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Gerik bus crash]]
**Fifteen people are killed and 33 others are injured in a [[traffic collision]] when a bus carrying students loses control and crashes into the back of a minivan on the [[East–West Highway (Malaysia)|East–West Highway]] near [[Gerik]], [[Perak]], [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250609-malaysia-bus-crash-kills-at-least-15-mostly-students (France 24)]
*Five people are killed, including an on duty railway police constable, and seven others are injured when passengers [[Railway accident|get thrown off]] two [[train surfing|overcrowded local trains]] at the [[Mumbra railway station]] near [[Mumbra]] in [[Thane, Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/mumbai/sharp-curve-led-to-mumbai-train-accident-grp-officer-10056616/ (''The Indian Express'')]
*The [[Indian Coast Guard]] rescues 18 crew members from a [[Singapore]]an-flagged [[container ship]] after it catches fire following an explosion {{convert|144|km|mi|abbr=on}} off the coast of [[Kerala]], [[India]]. Search operations are underway for the missing four crew members. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-rescues-crewmembers-from-burning-cargo-ship-off-kerala/a-72842715 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
**The [[Israeli Navy]] seizes the [[June 2025 Gaza Freedom Flotilla]]'s flagship vessel, the [[United Kingdom]]-flagged ''Madleen'', and takes its occupants (including Swedish activist [[Greta Thunberg]] and [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] [[Rima Hassan]]) to [[Israel]]. The [[humanitarian aid]] the ship was carrying en route to [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] will still be sent into Gaza. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/gaza-bound-activist-boat-towed-to-ashdod-port-after-israeli-interception/ (The Times of Israel)][https://edition.cnn.com/2025/06/08/middleeast/freedom-flotilla-gaza-aid-ship-thunberg-intl-hnk (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/jun/09/live-israel-gaza-aid-ship-madleen-freedom-flotilla-coalition-greta-thunberg?filterKeyEvents=false&page=with%3Ablock-68462bda8f08d8006b374b1b#block-68462bda8f08d8006b374b1b (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against Donald Trump]]
**[[June 2025 Los Angeles protests]]
***[[United States|U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] orders the deployment of roughly 500 [[United States Marine Corps|Marines]] to [[Los Angeles]] to protect federal buildings amid the ongoing riots in Los Angeles, California. [https://www.wsj.com/politics/national-security/marines-are-deploying-to-los-angeles-area-fe9a4ed6 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
***The [[U.S. state]] of [[California]] sues the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Donald Trump administration]] for deploying the [[California National Guard|National Guard]] to [[Los Angeles]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-national-guard-california-lawsuit-gavin-newsom/ (CBS News)]
***The city of [[Glendale, California|Glendale]] ends a contract with the [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] (ICE) to house federal immigration detainees. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jun/09/glendale-terminates-divisive-ice-detainee-holding-contract (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 Ballymena riots]]
**Two police cars and multiple properties are damaged in [[Ballymena]], Northern Ireland, with 15 police officers being injured and one rioter arrested amid riots which broke out after two Romanian teenagers were charged for the attempted rape of a teenage girl. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg4v04p008o (BBC News)]
*A court in [[Prague]], [[Czech Republic]], sentences a [[Colombians|Colombian national]] to eight years in prison over a 2024 [[arson]] attack on public buses and for planning another similar attack. Czech prime minister [[Petr Fiala]] says the arson attack is part of [[Russia]]'s hybrid war against his country. [https://apnews.com/article/czech-russia-arson-attack-colombian-telegram-b1c71ecf929ca176ad059ffbc3952d80 (AP)]
*The [[U.S. Treasury Department]] imposes sanctions on [[Iván Archivaldo Guzmán Salazar]] and his brother {{ill|Jesús Alfredo Guzmán Salazar|es}}, [[El Chapo]]'s sons who are believed to be in [[Mexico]] and leading factions of the [[Sinaloa Cartel]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-treasury-sanctions-mexico-el-chapo-5a72a61741379e826b1aefcb2296c624 (AP)]
